summary: v08 as a single decision with a stated probability, for pool models without log-probabilities: the judgement session only (no verification); the case score is the submitted p_ischemic.

Aspect C (reasoning procedure): v08p with judgement.md replaced by a six-item candidate-specific scoring worksheet (change size, time course, QRS timing, heart-rate response, shape, rhythm; each -2..+2 with card-cited directions both ways), an explicit list of record-wide properties that are not evidence (lead set, other candidates, eligibility flags), and p_ischemic = 0.5 + 0.08 x score.

Aspect A (knowledge): v08p with the Reference knowledge of context.md extended by card-cited two-way entries on QRS changes (ischemic QRS change K18/K19 vs positional/artifact steps K14/K15/K27), heart-rate timing and rise size (K01/K02/K04/K08), depression depth and upslope (K24-K26), ST elevation (K28/K29/K32, replacing the uncarded COVADIS citation) and other episodes of the patient (K43), with the matching lines of the usage guidance.

Aspect C (reasoning procedure): xac02 with judgement.md replaced by an anchor-and-adjust procedure that starts p_ischemic from the size of the change in literature bands (100/150/200 uV, ACC/AHA, K17, K26), adjusts it with bounded two-way card-cited items (timing K01/K02, steady rate K29/K08, shape K24-K26, synchronous QRS/ST steps K14/K27/K36, slow-rate elevation K32, rise size K04), and counts as non-evidence the rate_response 'beyond usual' finding that nearly every candidate shows, with the matching heart-rate line of the usage guidance.

Aspect C (reasoning procedure): xac03 with the heart-rate timing item of judgement.md turned into a fixed three-class read-out of episode_dynamics hr_max_minus_st_peak_s (a+ = heart rate peaked 15 s to 5 min before the ST extremum, +0.10/+0.15, K01/K02/K03; a0-early = more than 5 min before, and a0-late = at or after the extremum, both 0 and not evidence either way, K08), with the lag and its class written in the rationale and the matching timing line of the usage guidance.
